text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's morning newspapers on Tuesday:
- Thunderstorms near Celje in eastern Slovenia caused floods and landslides on Monday.
- A new law on takeovers of Slovenian companies comes into force on Tuesday.

- Slovenia's President Milan Kucan met the vice-president of the Bosnian federation Ejup Ganic on Monday. They discussed the relations between the two countries and problems regarding the return of Bosnian refugees to their homes.
- Some 800 young Slovenians went on a pilgrimage to Paris to take part in a World meeting of Catholic Youth.
- The number of unemployed in the Ljubljana region fell by 0.5 percent to 28,900, Slovenia's employment office said.
- Slovenia's June average gross monthly salary was 143,603 tolars ($857.3), a 13.1 percent increase from June 1996, the statistical office reported on Monday.
